    remove_variable = mwp_auto_takeover

    remove_variable = mwp_script_purchase_error
    remove_variable = mwp_script_purchase_verified
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_auto_status
        value = 0
    }
    mwp_d19_transaction_recover_effect = yes
}
mwp_auto_cancel_effect = {
    remove_variable = mwp_auto_owner
    remove_variable = mwp_auto_phase
    remove_variable = mwp_auto_dispatch_armed
}

            mwp_d21_selected_wallet_value >= var:mwp_script_selected_price

                has_variable = mwp_script_purchase_error

                        }
                        var:mwp_script_selected_regiment = {
                            is_regular_maa_regiment = yes
                            mwp_d21_selected_regiment_route_trigger = yes
                            regiment_owner = {
                                this = scope:mwp_script_player
                            }
                            is_maa_type = cannon
                            can_upgrade_maa = yes
                        }
                    }
                    var:mwp_script_selected_regiment = {
                        save_scope_value_as = {
                            name = mwp_script_size_before
                            value = maa_size
                        }
                        save_scope_value_as = {
                            name = mwp_script_troops_before
                            value = maa_current_troops_count
                        }
                        change_maa_regiment_size = {
                            size = 1
                            reinforce = no
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                root = {
                                    mwp_d21_nomad_mode_value = 1
                                }
                            }
                            change_maa_troops_count = {
                                value = maa_max_troops_count
                                subtract = maa_current_troops_count
                            }
                            save_scope_value_as = {
                                name = mwp_script_troops_before
                                value = maa_current_troops_count
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            mwp_d21_route_count_value = var:mwp_auto_last_count_before
                            var:mwp_script_selected_regiment = {
                                maa_size = {
                                    value = scope:mwp_script_size_before
                                    add = 1
                                }
                                maa_current_troops_count = scope:mwp_script_troops_before
                            }
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            name = mwp_script_mutated_regiment
                            value = var:mwp_script_selected_regiment
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            name = mwp_script_purchase_verified
                            value = yes
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_variable = mwp_script_purchase_verified
                    mwp_d21_selected_wallet_value = var:mwp_auto_last_gold_before
                }
                mwp_d21_debit_selected_effect = yes
                mwp_d21_nomad_debit_herd_effect = yes
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_auto_last_gold_after
                    value = mwp_d21_selected_wallet_value
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_auto_last_count_after
                    value = mwp_d21_route_count_value
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_auto_last_regiment
                    value = var:mwp_script_mutated_regiment
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        mwp_d21_selected_wallet_value = mwp_d21_primitive_expected_wallet_value
                        mwp_d21_nomad_post_herd_trigger = yes
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        name = mwp_auto_last_paid_verified
                        value = yes
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        name = mwp_auto_status
                        value = 8
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            NOT = {
                                has_variable = mwp_auto_purchase_count
                            }
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            name = mwp_auto_purchase_count
                            value = 0
                        }
                    }
                    change_variable = {
                        name = mwp_auto_purchase_count
                        add = 1
                    }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = {
                        name = mwp_script_purchase_error
                        value = yes
                    }
                }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_script_purchase_error
                    value = yes
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_variable = mwp_script_purchase_error
                }
                remove_variable = mwp_auto_recruit_enabled
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_auto_status
                    value = 15
                }
            }
        }
        remove_variable = mwp_d21_wallet_refund_ready
    }

                                                var:mwp_auto_purchase_count = var:mwp_batch_count_expected
                                            }
                                            mwp_native_cost_invalidate_effect = yes
                                            change_variable = {
                                                name = mwp_batch_steps
                                                add = 1
                                            }
                                            if = {
                                                limit = {
                                                    mwp_d21_selected_legacy_gold_trigger = yes
                                                }
                                                change_variable = {
                                                    name = mwp_batch_reserved_upkeep
                                                    add = var:mwp_script_selected_upkeep
                                                }
                                            }
                                            if = {
                                                limit = {
                                                    mwp_d21_selected_legacy_gold_trigger = yes
                                                }
                                                change_variable = {
                                                    name = mwp_batch_remaining_headroom
                                                    subtract = var:mwp_script_selected_upkeep
                                                }
                                            }
                                            set_variable = {
                                                name = mwp_auto_B
                                                value = var:mwp_batch_remaining_headroom
                                            }
                                            if = {
                                                limit = {
                                                    var:mwp_script_selected_action = 1
                                                }
                                                remove_variable = mwp_batch_continue
                                            }
                                            else = {
                                                var:mwp_script_selected_regiment = {
                                                    save_scope_value_as = {
                                                        name = mwp_batch_capacity_left
                                                        value = {
                                                            value = maa_max_troops_count
                                                            multiply = scope:mwp_batch_size_before
                                                        }
                                                    }
                                                    save_scope_value_as = {
                                                        name = mwp_batch_capacity_right
                                                        value = {
                                                            value = scope:mwp_batch_max_before
                                                            multiply = maa_size
                                                        }
                                                    }
                                                }
                                                if = {
                                                    limit = {
                                                        NOT = {
                                                            AND = {
                                                                scope:mwp_batch_size_before > 0
                                                                scope:mwp_batch_max_before > 0
                                                                var:mwp_script_selected_regiment = {
                                                                    maa_max_troops_count > 0
                                                                    maa_current_troops_count = scope:mwp_batch_troops_before
                                                                    maa_size = {
                                                                        value = scope:mwp_batch_size_before
                                                                        add = 1
                                                                    }
                                                                }
                                                                scope:mwp_batch_capacity_left = scope:mwp_batch_capacity_right
                                                            }
                                                        }
                                                    }
                                                    remove_variable = mwp_batch_continue
                                                }
                                                mwp_dev11_refresh_siege_priorities_effect = yes
                                                mwp_dev13_refresh_combat_batch_effect = yes
                                            }
                                        }
                                        else = {
                                            remove_variable = mwp_batch_continue
                                        }
                                    }
                                    else = {
                                        remove_variable = mwp_batch_continue
                                    }
                                }
                                remove_variable = mwp_d18_mixed_batch
                                remove_variable = mwp_batch_continue
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    else = {
                        set_variable = {
                            name = mwp_auto_status
                            value = 13
                        }
                    }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = {
                        name = mwp_auto_status
                        value = 14
                    }
                }
            }
            remove_variable = mwp_batch_active
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        var:mwp_batch_steps > 0
                        has_variable = mwp_d19_transaction_rebuild_requested
                    }
                }
                remove_variable = mwp_d19_transaction_rebuild_requested
                mwp_request_own_analysis_effect = yes
            }
        }
    }
}

mwp_script_budget_refresh_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_variable = mwp_d21p_pending
            }
        }
        mwp_d21_legacy_budget_refresh_effect = yes
        mwp_d21_budget_refresh_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    mwp_d21_upkeep_free_trigger = yes
                    mwp_auto_budget_mode_value = 3
                    mwp_d21_budget_ledger_current_trigger = yes
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_script_budget_ready
                value = yes
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_script_budget_error
                value = 0
            }
        }
    }
}

mwp_dev14_wait_status_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = mwp_auto_status
            var:mwp_auto_status = 7
            NOT = {
                has_variable = mwp_script_selected_id
            }
            NOT = {
                has_variable = mwp_reorganization_planned_id
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    has_variable = mwp_script_has_candidate
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_auto_status
                value = 12
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    has_variable = mwp_script_has_gold
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_auto_status
                value = 6
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    mwp_auto_budget_mode_value = 3
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_auto_status
                value = 5
            }
        }
        else = {
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_auto_status
                value = 12
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = mwp_auto_status
            has_variable = mwp_d19_reject_skipped_this_select
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:mwp_auto_status = 12
                NOT = {
                    mwp_auto_budget_mode_value = 3
                }
                NOT = {
                    has_variable = mwp_script_selected_id
                }
                NOT = {
                    has_variable = mwp_reorganization_planned_id
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_auto_status
                value = 5
            }
        }
    }
}

mwp_d16t_finish_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = mwp_d16t_owner
            var:mwp_d16t_owner = this
            is_ai = no
            has_variable = mwp_d16t_collecting
            var:mwp_d16t_collecting = yes
            has_variable = mwp_generation
            var:mwp_d16t_generation = var:mwp_generation
            days_since_birth = var:mwp_d16t_day
            mwp_native_cost_purchase_count_value = var:mwp_d16t_purchase_count
            max_military_strength = var:mwp_d16t_max_strength
            var:mwp_d16t_received = var:mwp_d16t_expected
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_d16t_sum_error
            value = {
                value = var:mwp_d16t_sum
                subtract = var:mwp_d16t_expenses
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_d16t_balance_error
            value = {
                value = var:mwp_d16t_income
                add = var:mwp_d16t_expenses
                subtract = var:mwp_d16t_balance
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_d16t_expenses_positive
            value = {
                value = var:mwp_d16t_expenses
                multiply = -1
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_d16t_military_positive
            value = {
                value = var:mwp_d16t_military
                multiply = -1
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:mwp_d16t_sum_error >= -0.001
                var:mwp_d16t_sum_error <= 0.001
                var:mwp_d16t_military <= 0
                var:mwp_d16t_military >= var:mwp_d16t_expenses
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_d16t_semantic_changed
                value = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_variable = mwp_fallback_cost_ready
                    has_variable = mwp_fallback_cost_owner
                    has_variable = mwp_fallback_cost_sequence
                    has_variable = mwp_fallback_cost_generation
                    has_variable = mwp_fallback_cost_day
                    has_variable = mwp_fallback_cost_purchase_count
                    has_variable = mwp_fallback_cost_max_strength
                    has_variable = mwp_fallback_cost_max_maa
                    has_variable = mwp_fallback_cost_levies
                    has_variable = mwp_fallback_cost_income
                    has_variable = mwp_fallback_cost_balance
                    has_variable = mwp_fallback_cost_expenses
                    has_variable = mwp_fallback_cost_current_military
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        var:mwp_fallback_cost_ready = yes
                        var:mwp_fallback_cost_owner = this
                        var:mwp_fallback_cost_generation = var:mwp_d16t_generation
                        var:mwp_fallback_cost_day = var:mwp_d16t_day
                        var:mwp_fallback_cost_purchase_count = var:mwp_d16t_purchase_count
                        var:mwp_fallback_cost_max_strength = var:mwp_d16t_max_strength
                        var:mwp_fallback_cost_max_maa = var:mwp_d16t_max_maa
                        var:mwp_fallback_cost_levies = var:mwp_d16t_levies
                        var:mwp_fallback_cost_income = var:mwp_d16t_income
                        var:mwp_fallback_cost_balance = var:mwp_d16t_balance
                        var:mwp_fallback_cost_expenses = var:mwp_d16t_expenses_positive
                        var:mwp_fallback_cost_current_military = var:mwp_d16t_military_positive
                    }
                    remove_variable = mwp_d16t_semantic_changed
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_variable = mwp_d16t_semantic_changed
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_fallback_cost_sequence
                    value = var:mwp_d16t_sequence
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_fallback_cost_owner
                value = this
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_fallback_cost_ready
                value = yes
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_fallback_cost_generation
                value = var:mwp_d16t_generation
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_fallback_cost_day
                value = var:mwp_d16t_day
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_fallback_cost_purchase_count
                value = var:mwp_d16t_purchase_count
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_fallback_cost_max_strength
                value = var:mwp_d16t_max_strength
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_fallback_cost_max_maa
                value = var:mwp_d16t_max_maa
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_fallback_cost_levies
                value = var:mwp_d16t_levies
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_fallback_cost_income
                value = var:mwp_d16t_income
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_fallback_cost_balance
                value = var:mwp_d16t_balance
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_fallback_cost_expenses
                value = var:mwp_d16t_expenses_positive
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_fallback_cost_current_military
                value = var:mwp_d16t_military_positive
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_fallback_cost_receipt_tick
                value = var:mwp_d16t_clock
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_fallback_cost_rows
                value = var:mwp_d16t_received
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_fallback_cost_military_rows
                value = var:mwp_d16t_military_rows
            }
        }
        else = {
            remove_variable = mwp_fallback_cost_ready
        }
        remove_variable = mwp_d16t_collecting
    }
}

    if = {
        limit = {

            has_variable = mwp_n16c_collecting
            var:mwp_n16c_collecting = yes

            var:mwp_n16c_purchase_count = mwp_native_cost_purchase_count_value
            var:mwp_n16c_max_strength = max_military_strength
            var:mwp_n16c_received = var:mwp_n16c_expected
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_n16c_sum_error
            value = {
                value = var:mwp_n16c_sum
                subtract = var:mwp_n16c_army_raw
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:mwp_n16c_sum_error >= -0.001
                var:mwp_n16c_sum_error <= 0.001
                var:mwp_n16c_maa_raw <= 0
                var:mwp_n16c_maa_raw >= var:mwp_n16c_army_raw
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = {
                        has_variable = mwp_native_cost_sequence
                    }
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_native_cost_sequence
                    value = 0
                }

mwp_d19_preserve_current_military_effect = {
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_d19_military_model_upkeep
        value = 0
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_d19_current_military_excess
        value = 0
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = mwp_script_budget_ready
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:mwp_script_budget_ready = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_variable = mwp_script_raised_army_upkeep
                    has_variable = mwp_script_budget_current_expenses
                    has_variable = mwp_fallback_cost_current_military
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        var:mwp_script_raised_army_upkeep >= 0
                        var:mwp_fallback_cost_current_military >= 0
                        var:mwp_script_budget_current_expenses >= var:mwp_fallback_cost_current_military
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        name = mwp_d19_military_model_upkeep
                        value = var:mwp_script_raised_army_upkeep
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        name = mwp_d19_current_military_excess
                        value = {
                            value = var:mwp_fallback_cost_current_military
                            subtract = var:mwp_d19_military_model_upkeep
                            min = 0
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        name = mwp_script_raised_army_upkeep
                        value = {
                            value = var:mwp_d19_military_model_upkeep
                            add = var:mwp_d19_current_military_excess
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        name = mwp_script_full_army_expense
                        value = {
                            value = var:mwp_script_budget_current_expenses
                            subtract = var:mwp_fallback_cost_current_military
                            add = var:mwp_script_raised_army_upkeep
                        }
                    }
                }
                else = {
                    remove_variable = mwp_script_budget_ready
                    set_variable = {
                        name = mwp_script_budget_error
                        value = 1
                    }
                }
            }
            else = {
                remove_variable = mwp_script_budget_ready
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_script_budget_error
                    value = 1
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

mwp_d19_transaction_rollback_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            mwp_d19_transaction_post_matches_trigger = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:mwp_d19_tx_action = 2
            }
            var:mwp_d19_tx_regiment = {
                change_maa_regiment_size = {
                    size = -1
                    reinforce = no
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        root = {
                            mwp_d21_nomad_mode_value = 1
                        }
                    }
                    change_maa_troops_count = {
                        value = root.var:mwp_d19_tx_current
                        subtract = maa_current_troops_count
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        else = {
            var:mwp_d19_tx_regiment = {
                destroy_maa_regiment = yes
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                mwp_d19_transaction_restored_trigger = yes
                mwp_d21_selected_wallet_value = mwp_d21_transaction_expected_wallet_value
                var:mwp_auto_purchase_count = var:mwp_d19_tx_expected_counter
                NOT = {
                    has_variable = mwp_d19_tx_refunded
                }
            }
            mwp_d21_refund_transaction_effect = yes
            mwp_d21_nomad_refund_herd_effect = yes
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_d19_tx_refunded
                value = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    mwp_d21_selected_wallet_value = var:mwp_d19_tx_gold
                    trigger_if = {
                        limit = {
                            mwp_d21_nomad_mode_value = 1
                        }
                        domicile = {
                            herd = root.var:mwp_d21_tx_herd_before
                        }
                    }
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_auto_purchase_count
                    value = var:mwp_d19_tx_counter
                }
                remove_variable = mwp_auto_last_paid_verified
                remove_variable = mwp_script_purchase_verified
                remove_variable = mwp_script_mutated_regiment
                remove_variable = mwp_batch_continue
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_d19_rollback_id
                    value = var:mwp_d19_tx_id
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_d19_rollback_owner
                    value = this
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_d19_rollback_day
                    value = var:mwp_d19_tx_day
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_d19_rollback_gold
                    value = var:mwp_d19_tx_gold
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_d19_rollback_expenses
                    value = var:mwp_d19_tx_expenses
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_d19_rollback_unraised
                    value = var:mwp_d19_tx_unraised
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_d19_transaction_status
                    value = 2
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_d19_transaction_rebuild_requested
                    value = yes
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_auto_status
                    value = 13
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        mwp_d21_selected_legacy_rejection_trigger = yes
                    }
                    mwp_d19_reject_record_effect = yes
                }
                else = {
                    mwp_d21_reject_record_effect = yes
                }
                mwp_native_cost_invalidate_effect = yes
                mwp_d19_transaction_clear_effect = yes
            }
            else = {
                mwp_d19_transaction_failure_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else = {
            mwp_d19_transaction_failure_effect = yes
        }
    }
    else = {
        mwp_d19_transaction_failure_effect = yes
    }

mwp_d19_transaction_recover_effect = {

        limit = {

            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = mwp_d19_tx_active
            }
            mwp_d19_transaction_failure_effect = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = mwp_d19_transaction_status
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    var:mwp_d19_transaction_status = 3
                }
                mwp_d19_transaction_failure_effect = yes
            }
        }
    }
}

    remove_variable = mwp_d19_net_initial_expenses
    remove_variable = mwp_d19_net_initial_balance
    remove_variable = mwp_d19_net_purchase_count
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                mwp_auto_budget_mode_value = 3
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = mwp_script_budget_ready
                has_variable = mwp_script_budget_income
                has_variable = mwp_fallback_cost_income
                has_variable = mwp_fallback_cost_expenses
                has_variable = mwp_fallback_cost_balance
                has_variable = mwp_fallback_cost_sequence
                has_variable = mwp_cost_cache_fallback_sequence
                has_variable = mwp_generation
                has_variable = mwp_auto_B
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    var:mwp_script_budget_ready = yes
                    mwp_fallback_cost_current_trigger = yes
                    var:mwp_cost_cache_fallback_sequence = var:mwp_fallback_cost_sequence
                    var:mwp_script_budget_income = var:mwp_fallback_cost_income
                    var:mwp_fallback_cost_expenses >= 0
                    monthly_character_expenses >= 0
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_d19_net_owner
                    value = this
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_d19_net_generation
                    value = var:mwp_generation
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_d19_net_day
                    value = days_since_birth
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_d19_net_mode
                    value = mwp_auto_budget_mode_value
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_d19_net_gross
                    value = var:mwp_fallback_cost_income
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_d19_net_initial_expenses
                    value = var:mwp_fallback_cost_expenses
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_d19_net_initial_balance
                    value = var:mwp_fallback_cost_balance
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_d19_net_purchase_count
                    value = mwp_native_cost_purchase_count_value
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_d19_net_income
                    value = {
                        value = var:mwp_fallback_cost_balance
                        add = var:mwp_fallback_cost_expenses
                        max = var:mwp_fallback_cost_income
                    }
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_d19_net_expense_limit
                    value = {
                        value = var:mwp_d19_net_income
                        subtract = 0.01
                    }
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_auto_B
                    value = {
                        value = var:mwp_d19_net_expense_limit
                        subtract = monthly_character_expenses
                        max = var:mwp_auto_B
                    }
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_d19_net_ready
                    value = yes
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    has_variable = mwp_d19_net_ready
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_auto_B
                value = -1
            }
            remove_variable = mwp_script_budget_ready
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_script_budget_error
                value = 1
            }
        }
    }
}

mwp_d19_reject_refresh_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = mwp_d19_reject_active
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = mwp_d19_reject_active
                has_variable = mwp_d19_reject_owner
                has_variable = mwp_d19_reject_mode
                has_variable = mwp_d19_reject_gold
                has_variable = mwp_d19_reject_expenses
                has_variable = mwp_d19_reject_unraised
                has_variable = mwp_d19_reject_capacity
                has_variable = mwp_d19_reject_count
                has_variable = mwp_d19_reject_enumerated_count
                has_variable = mwp_d19_reject_slots
                has_variable = mwp_d19_reject_ratio
                has_variable = mwp_d19_reject_zero_low
                has_variable = mwp_d19_reject_income
                has_variable = mwp_d19_reject_nonmilitary
                has_variable = mwp_d19_reject_net_income
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        NOT = {
                            var:mwp_d19_reject_owner = this
                        }
                        NOT = {
                            var:mwp_d19_reject_mode = mwp_auto_budget_mode_value
                        }
                        NOT = {
                            var:mwp_d19_reject_gold = gold
                        }
                        NOT = {
                            var:mwp_d19_reject_expenses = monthly_character_expenses
                        }
                        NOT = {
                            var:mwp_d19_reject_unraised = monthly_character_men_at_arms_expense_gold
                        }
                        NOT = {
                            var:mwp_d19_reject_capacity = mwp_cost_cache_actual_capacity_value
                        }
                        NOT = {
                            var:mwp_d19_reject_count = maa_regiments_count
                        }
                        NOT = {
                            var:mwp_d19_reject_enumerated_count = mwp_cost_cache_regiment_count_value
                        }
                        NOT = {
                            var:mwp_d19_reject_slots = maa_regiments_max_count
                        }
                        NOT = {
                            var:mwp_d19_reject_ratio = mwp_cost_cache_bound_ratio_value
                        }
                        NOT = {
                            var:mwp_d19_reject_zero_low = mwp_cost_cache_zero_low_value
                        }
                    }
                }
                mwp_d19_reject_clear_effect = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_variable = mwp_d19_reject_active
                }
                every_maa_regiment = {
                    save_scope_as = mwp_d19_reject_live_regiment
                    root = {
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                has_variable_list = mwp_d19_reject_roster
                            }
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    NOT = {
                                        is_target_in_variable_list = {
                                            name = mwp_d19_reject_roster
                                            target = scope:mwp_d19_reject_live_regiment
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                                mwp_d19_reject_clear_effect = yes
                            }
                        }
                        else = {
                            mwp_d19_reject_clear_effect = yes
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_variable = mwp_d19_reject_active
                    has_variable = mwp_script_budget_ready
                    has_variable = mwp_script_budget_income
                    has_variable = mwp_fallback_cost_expenses
                    has_variable = mwp_fallback_cost_current_military
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        var:mwp_script_budget_ready = yes
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        name = mwp_d19_reject_observed_nonmilitary
                        value = {
                            value = var:mwp_fallback_cost_expenses
                            subtract = var:mwp_fallback_cost_current_military
                        }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            OR = {
                                NOT = {
                                    var:mwp_d19_reject_income = var:mwp_script_budget_income
                                }
                                NOT = {
                                    var:mwp_d19_reject_nonmilitary = var:mwp_d19_reject_observed_nonmilitary
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        mwp_d19_reject_clear_effect = yes
                    }
                    remove_variable = mwp_d19_reject_observed_nonmilitary
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_variable = mwp_d19_reject_active
                    has_variable = mwp_script_budget_ready
                    has_variable = mwp_d19_net_ready
                    has_variable = mwp_d19_net_owner
                    has_variable = mwp_d19_net_generation
                    has_variable = mwp_generation
                    has_variable = mwp_d19_net_day
                    has_variable = mwp_d19_net_mode
                    has_variable = mwp_d19_net_purchase_count
                    has_variable = mwp_d19_net_income
                    has_variable = mwp_d19_net_gross
                    has_variable = mwp_script_budget_income
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        var:mwp_script_budget_ready = yes
                        var:mwp_d19_net_ready = yes
                        var:mwp_d19_net_owner = this
                        var:mwp_d19_net_generation = var:mwp_generation
                        var:mwp_d19_net_day = days_since_birth
                        var:mwp_d19_net_mode = mwp_auto_budget_mode_value
                        var:mwp_d19_net_purchase_count = mwp_native_cost_purchase_count_value
                        var:mwp_d19_net_gross = var:mwp_script_budget_income
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            NOT = {
                                var:mwp_d19_reject_net_income = var:mwp_d19_net_income
                            }
                        }
                        mwp_d19_reject_clear_effect = yes
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        else = {
            mwp_d19_reject_clear_effect = yes
        }
    }

mwp_d19_refresh_army_scope_effect = {
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_d19_whole_army_available
        value = no
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            mwp_d19_whole_army_supported_trigger = yes
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_d19_whole_army_available
            value = yes
        }
    }
}
mwp_d19_cap_army_scope_effect = {
    mwp_d19_refresh_army_scope_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            mwp_auto_budget_mode_value = 1
            var:mwp_d19_whole_army_available = no
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_auto_B
            value = -1
        }
    }
}

mwp_d21_legacy_budget_refresh_effect = {
    remove_variable = mwp_script_budget_ready
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_d18_army_factor
        value = mwp_d18_army_factor_value
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_d18_army_exact
        value = mwp_d18_army_exact_value
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_script_budget_error
        value = 1
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_script_budget_native
        value = 0
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_script_budget_income
        value = 0
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_script_maa_upkeep
        value = 0
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_script_raised_army_upkeep
        value = 0
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_script_full_army_expense
        value = 0
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = scope:mwp_input_cost_panel_open
            scope:mwp_input_cost_panel_open = yes
            mwp_native_cost_current_trigger = yes
            mwp_fallback_cost_current_trigger = yes
            exists = scope:mwp_input_fallback_cost_sequence
            scope:mwp_input_fallback_cost_sequence = var:mwp_fallback_cost_sequence
            exists = scope:mwp_input_native_cost_sequence
            scope:mwp_input_native_cost_sequence = var:mwp_native_cost_sequence
            exists = scope:mwp_input_cost_max_maa
            scope:mwp_input_cost_max_maa = var:mwp_native_cost_max_maa
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_script_budget_income
            value = var:mwp_fallback_cost_income
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_script_budget_current_expenses
            value = var:mwp_fallback_cost_expenses
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_script_maa_upkeep
            value = {
                value = var:mwp_native_cost_maa
                multiply = var:mwp_d18_army_factor
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_script_raised_army_upkeep
            value = {
                value = var:mwp_fallback_cost_levies
                multiply = mwp_script_levy_per_soldier_bound
                add = var:mwp_script_maa_upkeep
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_script_full_army_expense
            value = {
                value = var:mwp_fallback_cost_expenses
                subtract = var:mwp_fallback_cost_current_military
                add = var:mwp_script_raised_army_upkeep
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_script_budget_error
            value = 0
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_script_budget_native
            value = 1
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_cost_cache_fallback_sequence
            value = scope:mwp_input_fallback_cost_sequence
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_script_budget_ready
            value = yes
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            mwp_fallback_cost_current_trigger = yes
            exists = scope:mwp_input_fallback_cost_sequence
            scope:mwp_input_fallback_cost_sequence = var:mwp_fallback_cost_sequence
            exists = scope:mwp_input_cost_max_maa
            scope:mwp_input_cost_max_maa = var:mwp_fallback_cost_max_maa
        }
        mwp_fallback_budget_calculate_effect = yes
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_cost_cache_fallback_sequence
            value = scope:mwp_input_fallback_cost_sequence
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_cost_cache_fallback_capacity
            value = mwp_cost_cache_actual_capacity_value
        }
    }
    mwp_d19_preserve_current_military_effect = yes
    mwp_d19_refresh_army_scope_effect = yes
}

mwp_d21_legacy_headroom_effect = {
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_auto_B
        value = {
            value = var:mwp_script_budget_income
            multiply = mwp_auto_income_fraction_value
            subtract = var:mwp_script_maa_upkeep
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            mwp_auto_budget_mode_value = 1
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_auto_B
            value = {
                value = var:mwp_script_budget_income
                subtract = var:mwp_script_full_army_expense
            }
        }
    }
    mwp_d19_cap_current_net_effect = yes
    mwp_d19_cap_army_scope_effect = yes
}
